outcome_rationale: Test indexing is SUPPORTED: the installed Graphify 0.1.14 runtime indexed all 20 src/test/java files and all 76 @Test methods (18-file/76-method baseline) are observable as provider method nodes with exact source locations. Test-to-production relationship evidence is INSUFFICIENT: the only provider-native cross-file relationship is the 'imports' edge (file-node granularity, basis = import declaration). Only 5 of 18 @Test-bearing test files (14 edges total across 6 test files, 13 of them in those 5 @Test-bearing files) resolve any import edge to a production file node; the other 13 test files expose zero provider-native production linkage because same-package references produce no import declaration and cross-file 'calls' edges do not exist (0 observed; call resolution is same-file label matching only). No @Test annotation or test-specific node/edge type is modeled, so test methods are indistinguishable from helper methods in the graph. Under the plan criteria, required test-to-production relationships are unavailable at the granularity a downstream extraction plan needs, so the single outcome is GAP. This classification does not authorize a Java fallback; per FRAMEWORK-SPEC PKB-REVERSE-002 a later bounded plan may add a Java-owned extractor adapter only after this verified gap.

relationship_evidence.directed_import_edges_derivation: 14 total directed test-file -> production-file 'imports' edges across 6 test files (service/ClinicServiceTests.java 8, PetClinicConcurrencyTests.java 2, MySqlIntegrationTests.java 1, PetClinicIntegrationTests.java 1, PostgresIntegrationTests.java 1, service/EntityUtils.java test-tree helper 1 -> BaseEntity.java); 13 of the 14 edges lie in the 5 @Test-bearing files counted by test_files_with_at_test_having_any_production_edge (5/18). Importer direction is determined by each edge's declaring source_file (the file containing the import declaration), not by the edge's source/target endpoint node ids: several 'imports' edges have flipped source/target endpoints, so a naive endpoint read undercounts or misdirects. Recomputed from the frozen graph bytes (graph-petclinic-818c413-main-and-test.json) by that rule, the count is 14 and equals the sum of per-file-inventory.json import_edges_to_production entries.
relationship_evidence.basis: extract.py creates one 'imports' edge per import_declaration whose imported simple type name matches the node id of an indexed file (stem-derived); edges are directed file-node to file-node and survive graph build only when both endpoints are indexed. Cross-file 'calls' edges are never produced for Java: call resolution matches method labels within the same file only (label_to_nid is per-file).

limitations: imports edges are file-node granularity only; no class- or method-level target and no distinction of which test method uses the import.

Same-package references (e.g. OwnerControllerTests -> OwnerController, ValidatorTests -> Validator) produce no import declaration and therefore no provider-native edge; 13 of 18 @Test-bearing test files show zero production linkage.
@Test, @BeforeEach and other annotations are not extracted; fixture/precondition and assertion evidence is absent from the graph.
Cross-file call resolution is Python-only in Graphify 0.1.14; Java call edges exist only within a single file (0 cross-file calls observed).

Node ids are stem-derived and checkout-specific absolute paths may appear in runtime provenance; the frozen graph bytes in this directory use repository-relative source_file paths captured from the staged copy.
5 of 30 production files were dropped as degree-0 isolated code nodes by graphify.build; dropped files can never be import-edge targets.
Graphify graph.json embeds no Git revision metadata; revision binding was established by controlled extraction from the validated immutable checkout (whole-tree archive digest recorded above).
